lastCompletedStory.title: Navigable Stories section with a pure selection reducer and green-highlighted selected row

nextStoryContext: US-005 added j/k/arrow navigation to the Stories section in Dashboard.tsx: (1) exported `selectionReducer(selected, dir, storyCount)` - pure reducer, clamps to [0,storyCount-1], no-ops on empty list; (2) added `selectedIdx` useState(0) and `stories` variable in DashboardApp; (3) wired useInput for j/downArrow (down) and k/upArrow (up) before the KEYBAR_COMMANDS dispatch block; (4) StoriesSection now accepts `selectedIdx` and computes the window around it (instead of currentId); (5) StoryRow accepts `isSelected` and renders a single <Text backgroundColor={colors.accent} color='#000000'>{line}</Text> when selected, preserving the glyph for pass-state semantics; (6) DARK constant (#000000) added locally in Dashboard.tsx. Tests: 6 pure reducer unit tests + 8 ink-testing-library navigation tests (initial render ANSI assertion, j/k/arrow keypresses with per-line ACCENT_BG checks, clamping, empty-list). Key gotcha: React 19 state updates from useInput are async; navigation tests need `await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 0))` after each stdin.write to let React flush before calling lastFrame(). chalk.level=3 forced in beforeAll for ANSI assertions. 806 tests pass.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Ink 7 docs confirmed: (1) useInput key object supports key.upArrow and key.downArrow for all arrow directions; (2) <Text backgroundColor> accepts hex values and is inherited by child <Text> components, same formats as color prop. Implementation matches.
